summary.headline: Modena Codices 14–16
summary.text: Catalog entries for Modena codices 14–16: codex 189 preserves philosophical works of Porphyry and Aristotle with astronomical diagrams and zodiacal verses; codex 215 includes Cleomedes on celestial motion, works or excerpts by John Pediasimus, lunar configurations, diagrams by Demetrius Triclinius and Nicolaus Cabasilas, and a Saturn attribution by Georgius Valla. Codex 239 is a moisture-damaged fifteenth-century astrological manuscript.
